issue_request: FHIR-32889 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core BodySite/BodyStructure terminology. It reported inactive SNOMED CT concepts 419161000 Unilateral left and 419465000 Unilateral right in the BodyStructure relative-location codelist and requested replacement with active concepts 7771000 Left and 24028007 Right.
initial_application: Jira comments identify PR commits 6a6285f57356293d5ce93970c2cf61dfad3b5233 and 35ef574d61ba4ab133fe86c61d4d88f964be3514 as application evidence. Git history also shows FHIR-29810 commit 29e94a49e4772ffe4ef30d988217564ea948c7b7 had already changed the same BodyStructure relative-location value set from inactive 419161000/419465000 to 7771000/24028007; the FHIR-32889 branch briefly carried 1dce04bcba9bd4aefaaeeaacc728964d02f22a25 before 35ef574d61ba4ab133fe86c61d4d88f964be3514 corrected the old laterality codes to Left (qualifier value) and Right (qualifier value).
additional_context: BodySite is now represented by the active BodyStructure resource in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-45256a refactoring split left/right/bilateral into source/bodystructure/valueset-bodystructure-laterality.xml and rebound BodyStructure.includedStructure.laterality to that value set. The related AutoFHIR FHIR-23866 commit already fixed remaining active BodyStructure examples that still used inactive 419161000. Current source and the read-only FHIR Extension Pack checkout contain no 419161000 or 419465000 occurrences.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the current BodyStructure laterality value set contains 7771000 and 24028007, the relative-location value set no longer carries laterality concepts, BodyStructure.includedStructure.laterality is bound to the active laterality value set, and active examples use 7771000 rather than the inactive left code.
